name: Csáfordjánosfa (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csáfordjánosfa: a red and blue shield with ears of grain and a heart, with a helm, a stork crest and grey mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csáfordjánosfa arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
